# THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD — Brand Portal

> The canonical brand system for THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD: visual identity,
> voice and messaging, and per-initiative brand guides. Point an AI assistant at
> this site to have it write, design, or review anything on-brand.

Brand tokens: midnight `#0B1A2D`, word blue `#023D6F`, parchment `#F7F3EC`,
flame `#F85842`, ember `#C13A24`.
Typefaces: DM Serif Display (headlines), DM Serif Text, DM Sans (body).
Standing brand law: text over video or photo footage uses a midnight scrim with
white type only, never Flame.

## Core guides

- [Brand Guide](https://brand.theword.world/brand): Full visual identity — logo usage, color system, typography, layout, and imagery rules.
- [Messaging Guide](https://brand.theword.world/brand/messaging): Voice, tone, vocabulary, and how we speak to every audience.

- [Initiative Brand Guides index](https://brand.theword.world/letterhead): Hub for each initiative's own brand expression under the parent brand.

- [Revival To My City](https://brand.theword.world/letterhead/revival-to-my-city)
